# NonEquilibriumInformationProcessing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Information processing that inherently relies on maintaining a non-equilibrium steady state, where energy input drives the system away from thermal equilibrium. Underpins the operation of active matter neuromorphic systems, linking energy dissipation to information encoding and computation.
